record.bible_text: He that is wounded in the stones<WH06481><WTH8803><WH01795>, or hath his privy member<WH08212> cut off<WH03772><WTH8803>, shall not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068>.

A bastard<WH04464> shall not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068>; even to his tenth<WH06224> generation<WH01755> shall he not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068>.

An Ammonite<WH05984> or Moabite<WH04125> shall not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068>; even to their tenth<WH06224> generation<WH01755> shall they not enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068> for<WH05704> ever<WH05769>:

Because<WH01697> they met<WH06923><WTH8765> you not with bread<WH03899> and with water<WH04325> in the way<WH01870>, when ye came forth<WH03318><WTH8800> out of Egypt<WH04714>; and because they hired<WH07936><WTH8804> against thee Balaam<WH01109> the son<WH01121> of Beor<WH01160> of Pethor<WH06604> of Mesopotamia<WH0763>, to curse<WH07043><WTH8763> thee.

Nevertheless the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> would<WH014><WTH8804> not hearken<WH08085><WTH8800> unto Balaam<WH01109>; but the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> turned<WH02015><WTH8799> the curse<WH07045> into a blessing<WH01293> unto thee, because the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> loved<WH0157><WTH8804> thee.
Thou shalt not seek<WH01875><WTH8799> their peace<WH07965> nor their prosperity<WH02896> all thy days<WH03117> for ever<WH05769>. <RF>prosperity: Heb. good<Rf>

Thou shalt not abhor<WH08581><WTH8762> an Edomite<WH0130>; for he <FI>is<Fi> thy brother<WH0251>: thou shalt not abhor<WH08581><WTH8762> an Egyptian<WH04713>; because thou wast a stranger<WH01616> in his land<WH0776>.
The children<WH01121> that are begotten<WH03205><WTH8735> of them shall enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into the congregation<WH06951> of the LORD<WH03068> in their third<WH07992> generation<WH01755>.<CM>
When the host<WH04264> goeth forth<WH03318><WTH8799> against thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, then keep<WH08104><WTH8738> thee from every wicked<WH07451> thing<WH01697>.

If there be among you any man<WH0376>, that is not clean<WH02889> by reason of uncleanness that chanceth<WH07137> him by night<WH03915>, then shall he go<WH03318><WTH8804> abroad<WH02351> out of the camp<WH04264>, he shall not come<WH0935><WTH8799> within<WH08432> the camp<WH04264>:

But it shall be, when evening<WH06153> cometh on<WH06437><WTH8800>, he shall wash<WH07364><WTH8799> <FI>himself<Fi> with water<WH04325>: and when the sun<WH08121> is down<WH0935><WTH8800>, he shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> into<WH08432> the camp<WH04264> <FI>again<Fi> . <RF>cometh...: Heb. turneth toward<Rf>
Thou shalt have a place also<WH03027> without<WH02351> the camp<WH04264>, whither thou shalt go forth<WH03318><WTH8804> abroad<WH02351>:

And thou shalt have a paddle<WH03489> upon thy weapon<WH0240>; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease<WH03427><WTH8800> thyself abroad<WH02351>, thou shalt dig<WH02658><WTH8804> therewith, and shalt turn back<WH07725><WTH8804> and cover<WH03680><WTH8765> that which cometh<WH06627> from thee: <RF>wilt...: Heb. sittest down<Rf>

For the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> walketh<WH01980><WTH8693> in the midst<WH07130> of thy camp<WH04264>, to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> thee, and to give up<WH05414><WTH8800> thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> before<WH06440> thee; therefore shall thy camp<WH04264> be holy<WH06918>: that he see<WH07200><WTH8799> no unclean<WH06172> thing<WH01697> in thee, and turn away<WH07725><WTH8804> from thee<WH0310>. <RF>unclean...: Heb. nakedness of any thing<Rf><CM>
Thou shalt not deliver<WH05462><WTH8686> unto his master<WH0113> the servant<WH05650> which is escaped<WH05337><WTH8735> from his master<WH0113> unto thee:

He shall dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> with thee, <FI>even<Fi> among<WH07130> you, in that place<WH04725> which he shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799> in one<WH0259> of thy gates<WH08179>, where it liketh him best<WH02896>: thou shalt not oppress<WH03238><WTH8686> him. <RF>liketh...: Heb. is good for him<Rf>
There shall be no whore<WH06948> of the daughters<WH01323> of Israel<WH03478>, nor a sodomite<WH06945> of the sons<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>whore: or, sodomitess<Rf>

Thou shalt not bring<WH0935><WTH8686> the hire<WH0868> of a whore<WH02181><WTH8802>, or the price<WH04242> of a dog<WH03611>, into the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> for any vow<WH05088>: for even both<WH08147> these <FI>are<Fi>  abomination<WH08441> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>.

Thou shalt not lend upon usury<WH05391><WTH8686> to thy brother<WH0251>; usury<WH05392> of money<WH03701>, usury<WH05392> of victuals<WH0400>, usury<WH05392> of any thing<WH01697> that is lent upon usury<WH05391><WTH8799>:

Unto a stranger<WH05237> thou mayest lend upon usury<WH05391><WTH8686>; but unto thy brother<WH0251> thou shalt not lend upon usury<WH05391><WTH8686>: that the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> may bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thee in all that thou settest<WH04916> thine hand<WH03027> to in the land<WH0776> whither thou goest<WH0935><WTH8802> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it.

When thou shalt vow<WH05087><WTH8799> a vow<WH05088> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, thou shalt not slack<WH0309><WTH8762> to pay<WH07999><WTH8763> it: for the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> will surely<WH01875><WTH8800> require<WH01875><WTH8799> it of thee; and it would be sin<WH02399> in thee.
But if thou shalt forbear<WH02308><WTH8799> to vow<WH05087><WTH8800>, it shall be no sin<WH02399> in thee.

That which is gone out<WH04161> of thy lips<WH08193> thou shalt keep<WH08104><WTH8799> and perform<WH06213><WTH8804>; <FI>even<Fi> a freewill offering<WH05071>, according as thou hast vowed<WH05087><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, which thou hast promised<WH01696><WTH8765> with thy mouth<WH06310>.

When thou comest<WH0935><WTH8799> into thy neighbour's<WH07453> vineyard<WH03754>, then thou mayest eat<WH0398><WTH8804> grapes<WH06025> thy fill<WH07648> at thine own pleasure<WH05315>; but thou shalt not put<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>any<Fi> in thy vessel<WH03627>.

When thou comest<WH0935><WTH8799> into the standing corn<WH07054> of thy neighbour<WH07453>, then thou mayest pluck<WH06998><WTH8804> the ears<WH04425> with thine hand<WH03027>; but thou shalt not move<WH05130><WTH8686> a sickle<WH02770> unto thy neighbour's<WH07453> standing corn<WH07054>.<CM>
